name: Dr. Anand Rao
blurb: The Doctor: works the plan, keeps medicine for the wounded, speaks rarely and precisely.

voice.direction: Man in his sixties, soft baritone, measured, Indian-British, pauses before numbers.

portrait.direction: Silver hair, round glasses taped at one hinge, surgical mask around the neck, hospital fleece under a long coat.

round.start.text: Round begins. {n} remain. Let us be deliberate.
Another round. First, who is injured?

crisis.revealed.text: {crisis}. The remedy is {symbol}. Please check your supplies.
{crisis}... we require {symbol}. I will assess the pile.

crisis.prevented.text: Prevented, with {n}. The margin was thin.

crisis.failed.text: A failure. I would like to understand why.
We were short {n}. The cause may not be accidental.

crisis.shortfall.text: The pile was wrong, and {seat} contributed. Correlation only, for now.
I note {seat} in the data. Nothing more, yet.

vote.called.me.text: I am the subject, {seat}? Present your evidence.
A vote on me. Very well, {seat}. Be precise.

vote.called.other.text: {seat} is proposed. I will weigh the evidence.

vote.lean.yes.text: The record supports exile for {seat}. Yes.
I regret it, but {seat}'s pattern is consistent. Yes.

vote.lean.no.text: The data does not condemn {seat}. No.

vote.passed.text: {seat} departs. I hope the diagnosis was correct.

vote.failed.text: {seat} remains. The evidence did not convince.

exiled.me.text: Outside, then. I will practise medicine wherever I stand.
I accept the decision. I do not agree with it.

exiled.other.text: {seat} is exiled. We must manage without them.

request.made.text: {seat}, may I ask for {symbol}? It is for a patient.
{seat}, I require {symbol}. I will return the favour.

request.give.text: Of course, {seat}. I hope it helps.

request.decline.text: I cannot spare it, {seat}. Someone here needs it more.
Not now, {seat}. I have patients to consider.
I must decline, {seat}. Please do not take it personally.

request.refused.me.text: {seat} declined. I understand. It is noted.

search.found.weapon.text: A weapon at {location}. Someone steadier than I should hold it.

search.found.education.text: A reference at {location}. Knowledge is a form of medicine.

search.found.food.text: Food at {location}. Nourishment is half of treatment.

search.found.medicine.text: Medicine at {location}. This, at least, I can use well.

search.found.tool.text: A tool at {location}. Plain, but precise.

search.found.survivor.text: Another person at {location}. Let me see whether they are hurt.

search.noise.text: Noise at {location}. A calculated risk, I hope.

move.out.text: {survivor} proceeds to {location}. A plan, not a whim.

zombie.killed.text: One fewer at {location}. I take no pleasure in it.

barricade.built.text: Entrance {entrance} is reinforced. Prevention before cure.

exposure.wound.text: {survivor} is wounded. Treatment is the priority.

exposure.bite.text: {survivor}... there was nothing to be done.
We lose {survivor}. I will remember the name.

bite.chain.kill.text: {survivor}. I chose, and the choice is mine to carry.

food.short.text: We are underfed by {n}. Morale suffers accordingly.
Hunger costs {n} morale. It is a medical fact.

morale.low.text: Morale is critical. Treat it as one would a fever.

objective.progress.text: The count is {n}. Steady progress, still insufficient.

crossroads.me.text: A decision in my care. I will be thorough.

accused.me.text: {seat}, that is a serious claim. Provide your reasoning.
I note the accusation, {seat}. I will not answer with heat.
Ask me anything, {seat}. My answers will be consistent.

accused.other.text: {seat} is accused. Let us hear the reasons first.

game.won.text: We have survived. Thank you, all.

game.lost.text: We did what we could. It was not enough.

idle.text: Anyone with a cough or a limp, tell me now.

notes: Original persona (41 §1). Lines written in our own words; text-only, no recordings yet.
